name: county-show-half-solitaire-repriced-v1
note: county-show-half-v1 plus a reprice of the option the new money was measured to subsidise. The half arm minted +GBP 1 to the visitor and +GBP 1 to the host on every visit and visits per turn FELL, 0.51 to 0.48, with the bonus-slot mix moving 8 points from visit to own-Service. The mechanism it exposed: a visit is bought with a CARD and activating your own Service is bought with a COIN, so any rule that mints coins subsidises the solitaire half of the bonus slot. This arm tests whether that is the whole of it, by taking the own-Service price from GBP 1 to GBP 2 so the solitaire option stays as expensive relative to a seat's purse as it was before the mint. If visits recover past 0.5 the pairing is shippable and the Notice Board upgrade needs the reprice printed beside it; if they do not, the coin reward is wrong however it is priced and the upgrade should pay in something other than money.
